paper_title: I Don't Know Explicit Modeling of Uncertainty with an [IDK] Token
caption: Average performance on closed-book factual sentence completion benchmarks of models in terms of their parameter count. 70m to 2.8B are , while 7.0B is .

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the average performance metrics of models with varying sizes. The x-axis represents "Model Size" on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 70 million (70m) to 7 billion (7.0B), with tick labels at intervals of 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B. The y-axis indicates "Avg. Performance (%)" on a linear scale, spanning from 20% to 80%, with tick labels at intervals of 20%. The plot features three lines: a red line with triangle markers that is solid, representing "Precision," starting at approximately 80% at 70m and ending just below 80% at 7.0B, with a slight decline in between. A blue line with triangle markers that is solid denotes "Recall," beginning at about 10% at 70m and increasing steadily to around 40% at 7.0B. The purple line with triangle markers that is solid represents the "F1-score," beginning just below 20% at 70m and rising progressively to almost 55% at 7.0B.A legend positioned near the bottom-right of the plot defines each line by its corresponding metrics, marker shape, and color
